metadata.dataset_name: RetroAltFest initial directory and map preview records
metadata.coordinate_policy: Latitude and longitude are intentionally null in this first pass unless exact venue geocoding has been verified. No coordinates have been guessed.
metadata.notes: Multi-city and multi-venue festivals are represented as parent records and flagged for follow-up child map records.

For RetroAltFest, it anchors the atlas as a benchmark for festivals that are more than a lineup — they are temporary nocturnal cities.
